prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE image, then copy the resulting image file to incoming/shelf-terrarium.png in this repo. Use a square size at the highest quality. Do not edit any other files. When done, print the saved path and the pixel dimensions.
The attached image (incoming/shelf-moss.png) is the reference: pass it to the image generation tool as the input image to edit, so the camera, framing and materials stay identical.

Image prompt:
Using the reference image, keep the same plaster wall, dark pine shelf edge, camera angle and soft daylight from the left. Replace the object with a clear hand-blown glass jar with a glass lid, about 40% of the frame width and taller than wide, holding a small landscape of green cushion moss, one small grey stone and a tiny fern. Soft natural reflections of the window light on the glass. Muted, natural colours, realistic photograph. No text, no people, no other objects. Square 1:1.
